label: Spray whipped cream
note: Aerosol can: nitrous oxide dissolves in the butterfat under pressure and foams as the can is released; CO2 would taste sour

about.text: Whipped cream sold in an aerosol can: the cream is charged with nitrous oxide, which dissolves in the butterfat under pressure and foams the cream as it leaves the can.
